request.prompt: Dark modern Tamil mass-hero entry BGM, electronic first. A thick distorted synth bass and layered analogue and digital synth textures carry the whole track; processed, resampled and glitchy hits punch on every bar; unique electronic sound design with strange metallic synth stabs and growls. 110 BPM in a heavy half-time swagger. Dark minor key in C sharp with menacing chromatic semitone bends. Low-mid heavy and dark: no bright hi-hats, no shimmering pads. Live instruments only as small colour: a nadaswaram doubling the hook. One catchy 4-note hook on a gritty synth lead, repeated again and again. Vocals: only deep male crowd chants and wordless shouts like 'hey!' and 'ho!' between phrases for energy, no lyrics, no singer. 0-2 s: a huge processed hit and a distorted synth-bass growl on the very first beat with a crowd shout, no intro. 2-16 s: menacing groove, synth bass leading, glitchy hits on every bar, metallic stabs answering the hook. 16-17 s: a one-second stop with a reversed synth swell. 17-50 s: louder, everything layered, a huge hit on every bar, the hook nonstop, chants answering every phrase. 50-60 s: the hook one last time with full chants, ending on one huge hit. Very loud, heavily compressed, wall-to-wall modern mix with no quiet sections.

brief.raga: Shanmukhapriya (Carnatic melakarta 56): fierce and heroic, minor colour with a raised 4th (prati madhyamam). The hero motif is 4 notes: Sa, Ri, Ga (minor), then a leap to the raised Ma, held.
brief.lead: nadaswaram (the hero's voice), with solo cello and bansuri for memory
